source: Parent read every selected issue annotation directly using pikepdf; for193/278/306, compared Rect/QuadPoints with pdftotext bbox positions. Confirmed193 two independent strikes and article replacement; note locator is7.2.2, physical36/printed21.

Transport rule can apply to application transport and is not established by lexer tests.
